description: Columns understood by the upload endpoint. Missing columns fall back to typical-traffic defaults. Aliases (e.g. CICIDS2017 headers) are mapped automatically.

addressing.ts: unix seconds, unix ms, or ISO-8601
addressing.payload_sample: request target / URL text; inspected by signature rules and text features
addressing.label: optional ground truth; enables accuracy evaluation

features.conn_count_src: connections from this source in a 60 s window (computed from src_ip when absent)
features.distinct_dst_ports: distinct ports contacted in window (computed when absent)
features.distinct_dst_hosts: distinct hosts contacted in window (computed when absent)
features.error_rate: 0-1 share of connections ending in error/RST
features.unusual_dest: 0/1 destination rarely contacted by this host
features.beacon_interval_std: std-dev of inter-connection interval (s); low = machine-regular
